cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?
